answer.description: Two to five sentences, grounded entirely in the passages. Say plainly when they do not cover the question.

citations.description: One per passage the answer leans on. Empty is correct when the passages do not answer the question.

node_id.description: Copied exactly from the passage header. Anything else is discarded.

chunk_id.description: Copied exactly from the passage header. Anything else is discarded.

quote.description: A substring of that passage. Not a paraphrase and not a sentence you wrote.
